pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita / criminal law

patterns: APPSC asks single facts: Tamil Nadu first state RTI law (1997), FOI Act 2002 repealed by RTI 2005, Section 4 = proactive disclosure.
Time-limit pair questions recur: 30 days normal, 48 hours life/liberty, 30 days first appeal; '45 days reply' is the planted wrong pair.
Chronology (Sweden 1766 -> UDHR 1948 -> FOI 2002 -> RTI 2005) and Section 8 'which is NOT exempt' items appear; Assertion-Reason on misuse/impact is a repeated shape.
Other PSCs ask assent date (15 June 2005), CIC set up 2005, MKSS link, who imposes Section 20 penalty, who cannot be an SIC (legislator).
App MCQs cover 2026 litigation (DPDP 8(1)(j), BCCI, Economic Survey) and pendency figures in depth beyond the PYQs; core section and time-limit items match APPSC style.
